commit 9555b335f4c47e8fd7e8b39609dd2db013836984
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Thu Sep 25 20:37:41 2025 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Thu Sep 25 20:37:41 2025 +0000

    Bug 1989872 - Fix stdc++ compatibility for ASAN/TSAN builds. r=jtracey
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D266237

diff --git a/build/unix/stdc++compat-tb.cpp b/build/unix/stdc++compat-tb.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..53e4c4c2e5e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/unix/stdc++compat-tb.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+/* This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+ * License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+ * file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. */
+
+ /* See stdc++compat.cpp in mozilla-central for general information. */
+
+#include <stdio.h>
+
+ /* operator delete with size is only available in CXXAPI_1.3.9, equivalent to
+  * GLIBCXX_3.4.21. Included here as workaround for bug 1989872. */
+ void operator delete(void* ptr, size_t size) noexcept(true) {
+   ::operator delete(ptr);
+ }
diff --git a/third_party/rnp/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
index 88347cecde5..70ea8f36571 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
@@ -243,4 +243,9 @@ if CONFIG["MZLA_LIBRNP_BACKEND"] == "openssl":
         "src/lib/crypto/symmetric_ossl.cpp",
     ]
 
+if CONFIG["MOZ_STDCXX_COMPAT"] and (CONFIG["MOZ_ASAN"] or CONFIG["MOZ_TSAN"]):
+    SOURCES += [
+        "/comm/build/unix/stdc++compat-tb.cpp"
+    ]
+
 DIRS += ["src/rnp", "src/rnpkeys"]
title: Bug 1989872 - Fix stdc++ compatibility for ASAN/TSAN builds. r=jtracey
